<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Link refused a live foreign parent's seat and close refused anyone but self or parent (F175 let a project's prime close only a dead parentless seat). A prime could not take or retire a seat whose parent was cold or busy elsewhere. One store predicate now names who acts as a prime, and both verbs consult it.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- A prime can take or retire any seat without the parent's cooperation.
- Every override is on the record and the displaced parent is told.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- No process or pane teardown on close.
- No change for non-primes.
- No change to who may be linked (a prime or the caller's ancestor still refuses).

<a id="research-context"></a>

## Research Context

Link authority lives in the store transaction `place_seat_committed` (crates/store/src/role_assertion.rs), refusing `E-RS-OWNERSHIP` for a live foreign parent. Close authority is `may_close` (crates/daemon/src/http/lifecycle.rs): self, parent, or F175's `prime_closes_dead_orphan` (a project's `prime_id`, parentless dead seats only), which this plan subsumes and removes. Primes in the store: `is_prime` (designation or role `prime`), `projects.prime_id`.

<a id="risks"></a>

## Risks

| risk | likelihood | impact | mitigation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A prime closes a busy seat by mistake. | Low | Medium | Close only tombstones (revive restores it); the act is audited and the parent told. |

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Cost: no loop, timer or launch. F282: one indexed `projects` read per link from a live foreign parent (inside its transaction) and per close by a non-owner; one FYI per override. F283: one alts-file read per Claude registration with no alt, then (only when a Claude alt names a home) one session file per Claude home; one such pass at daemon start.
